mouvements_stock_transfert_contrepartie.name: mouvements_stock_transfert_contrepartie
mouvements_stock_transfert_contrepartie.value:
("mouvements_stock"."type" <> 'transfert' AND "mouvements_stock"."depot_contrepartie_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("mouvements_stock"."type" = 'transfert' AND "mouvements_stock"."depot_contrepartie_id" IS NOT NULL
              AND "mouvements_stock"."depot_contrepartie_id" <> "mouvements_stock"."depot_id")

sessions_caisse_cloture_datee.name: sessions_caisse_cloture_datee
sessions_caisse_cloture_datee.value:
("sessions_caisse"."statut" = 'ouverte' AND "sessions_caisse"."cloturee_le" IS NULL)
          OR ("sessions_caisse"."statut" = 'cloturee' AND "sessions_caisse"."cloturee_le" IS NOT NULL)

employees_terme_selon_contrat.name: employees_terme_selon_contrat
employees_terme_selon_contrat.value:
("employees"."contrat" = 'cdi' AND "employees"."fin" IS NULL)
          OR ("employees"."contrat" <> 'cdi' AND "employees"."fin" IS NOT NULL AND "employees"."fin" >= "employees"."debut")

pieces_employe_fichier_complet.name: pieces_employe_fichier_complet
pieces_employe_fichier_complet.value: ("pieces_employe"."chemin" IS NULL) = ("pieces_employe"."nom_fichier" IS NULL) AND ("pieces_employe"."chemin" IS NULL) = ("pieces_employe"."type_mime" IS NULL)

pieces_employe_dates.name: pieces_employe_dates
pieces_employe_dates.value: "pieces_employe"."expire_le" IS NULL OR "pieces_employe"."delivree_le" IS NULL OR "pieces_employe"."expire_le" >= "pieces_employe"."delivree_le"

echeances_un_declencheur.name: echeances_un_declencheur
echeances_un_declencheur.value: "echeances"."echeance_le" IS NOT NULL OR "echeances"."compteur_cible" IS NOT NULL

documents_rattachement_complet.name: documents_rattachement_complet
documents_rattachement_complet.value:
("documents"."entite_type" IS NULL AND "documents"."entite_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("documents"."entite_type" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."entite_id" IS NOT NULL)

archives_retrait_motive.name: archives_retrait_motive
archives_retrait_motive.value: "archives"."retiree_le" IS NULL OR "archives"."motif_retrait" IS NOT NULL

reunions_ouverte_datee.name: reunions_ouverte_datee
reunions_ouverte_datee.value: "reunions"."statut" NOT IN ('en_cours', 'terminee') OR "reunions"."ouverte_le" IS NOT NULL

regularisations_avance_complete.name: regularisations_avance_complete
regularisations_avance_complete.value: ("regularisations_avance"."type" = 'justification' AND "regularisations_avance"."nature" IS NOT NULL) OR ("regularisations_avance"."type" = 'remboursement' AND "regularisations_avance"."caisse_id" IS NOT NULL)

bulletins_paie_paye.name: bulletins_paie_paye
bulletins_paie_paye.value: "bulletins_paie"."paye_le" IS NULL OR "bulletins_paie"."paiement_ecriture" IS NOT NULL

periodes_paie_validee.name: periodes_paie_validee
periodes_paie_validee.value: "periodes_paie"."statut" = 'preparation' OR ("periodes_paie"."ecriture" IS NOT NULL AND "periodes_paie"."bareme_applique" IS NOT NULL)

missions_issue_motivee.name: missions_issue_motivee
missions_issue_motivee.value: "missions"."statut" NOT IN ('echouee', 'annulee') OR "missions"."motif" IS NOT NULL

preuves_mission_contenu.name: preuves_mission_contenu
preuves_mission_contenu.value:
CASE "preuves_mission"."type"
        WHEN 'position' THEN "preuves_mission"."latitude_micro" IS NOT NULL AND "preuves_mission"."longitude_micro" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'photo' THEN "preuves_mission"."fichier_cle" IS NOT NULL
        WHEN 'formulaire' THEN "preuves_mission"."reponse_id" IS NOT NULL
        ELSE "preuves_mission"."texte" IS NOT NULL
      END

preuves_mission_position_bornee.name: preuves_mission_position_bornee
preuves_mission_position_bornee.value:
("preuves_mission"."latitude_micro" IS NULL OR "preuves_mission"."latitude_micro" BETWEEN -90000000 AND 90000000)
        AND ("preuves_mission"."longitude_micro" IS NULL OR "preuves_mission"."longitude_micro" BETWEEN -180000000 AND 180000000)

ressources_tarifs_positifs.name: ressources_tarifs_positifs
ressources_tarifs_positifs.value:
coalesce("ressources"."tarif_jour", 0) >= 0 AND coalesce("ressources"."tarif_semaine", 0) >= 0
        AND coalesce("ressources"."tarif_mois", 0) >= 0 AND "ressources"."caution" >= 0

operations_guichet_annulation_motivee.name: operations_guichet_annulation_motivee
operations_guichet_annulation_motivee.value: "operations_guichet"."annulee_le" IS NULL OR "operations_guichet"."motif" IS NOT NULL

sessions_guichet_cloture_complete.name: sessions_guichet_cloture_complete
sessions_guichet_cloture_complete.value: "sessions_guichet"."statut" = 'ouverte' OR ("sessions_guichet"."especes_comptees" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions_guichet"."ecart_especes" IS NOT NULL)

depenses_paiement_complet.name: depenses_paiement_complet
depenses_paiement_complet.value: "depenses"."statut" <> 'payee' OR ("depenses"."payee_le" IS NOT NULL AND "depenses"."moyen" IS NOT NULL)

depenses_refus_motive.name: depenses_refus_motive
depenses_refus_motive.value: "depenses"."statut" NOT IN ('rejetee', 'annulee') OR "depenses"."motif" IS NOT NULL

pieces_projet_rattachee.name: pieces_projet_rattachee
pieces_projet_rattachee.value: "pieces_projet"."projet_id" IS NOT NULL OR "pieces_projet"."depense_id" IS NOT NULL

projets_periode.name: projets_periode
projets_periode.value: "projets"."fin" IS NULL OR "projets"."debut" IS NULL OR "projets"."fin" >= "projets"."debut"

conversations_nom_groupe.name: conversations_nom_groupe
conversations_nom_groupe.value: "conversations"."type" = 'privee' OR ("conversations"."nom" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("conversations"."nom")) > 0)

messages_contenu.name: messages_contenu
messages_contenu.value: "messages"."corps" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."chemin" IS NOT NULL OR "messages"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL

prestations_montants.name: prestations_montants
prestations_montants.value: ("prestations"."montant_convenu" IS NULL OR "prestations"."montant_convenu" >= 0) AND ("prestations"."retenue" IS NULL OR "prestations"."retenue" >= 0)

prestations_payee.name: prestations_payee
prestations_payee.value: "prestations"."statut" <> 'payee' OR ("prestations"."montant_paye" IS NOT NULL AND "prestations"."ecriture_numero" IS NOT NULL)

soumissions_montants.name: soumissions_montants
soumissions_montants.value: ("soumissions"."budget_estime" IS NULL OR "soumissions"."budget_estime" >= 0) AND ("soumissions"."montant_propose" IS NULL OR "soumissions"."montant_propose" >= 0) AND ("soumissions"."caution" IS NULL OR "soumissions"."caution" >= 0)

presences_qui.name: presences_qui
presences_qui.value: "presences"."user_id" IS NOT NULL OR "presences"."employee_id" IS NOT NULL

commandes_salle_une_ouverte_par_table.name: commandes_salle_une_ouverte_par_table
commandes_salle_une_ouverte_par_table.where: "commandes_salle"."statut" = 'ouverte' AND "commandes_salle"."table_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commandes_salle"."deleted_at" IS NULL

reponses_enquete_position_bornee.name: reponses_enquete_position_bornee
reponses_enquete_position_bornee.value:
("reponses_enquete"."latitude_micro" IS NULL OR "reponses_enquete"."latitude_micro" BETWEEN -90000000 AND 90000000)
        AND ("reponses_enquete"."longitude_micro" IS NULL OR "reponses_enquete"."longitude_micro" BETWEEN -180000000 AND 180000000)
